questions.reference:
import math
def stable_softmax(logits: list[float]) -> list[float]:
    if not logits or any(type(x) not in (int,float) or not math.isfinite(x) for x in logits):
        raise ValueError("finite logits required")
    peak = max(logits)
    weights = [math.exp(x-peak) for x in logits]
    total = math.fsum(weights)
    return [w/total for w in weights]
